summary: @ornikar/monorepo-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs the Bun binary to run a locally-shipped math_init.js — a ~727 KB single-line obfuscated bundle marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' with hex-mangled identifiers, a large constant table, and a string-array rotation dispatcher (WV8StW push/shift pattern). The setup.mjs entrypoint itself uses dictionary-indirection obfuscation with _0x-prefixed identifiers and property-alias objects to hide its behavior. The declared purpose of the package is monorepo configuration helpers, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque bundled payload executed at install time. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern is used to evade Node-only static scanners: the actual behavior of the payload is hidden inside a Bun-format bundle that npm's Node-based tooling does not readily introspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
